title.narrative: In the reporting period, the 2024-2025 Multi-Year Work Plan (MYWP) was endorsed by the Government. The overall monitoring framework was enhanced with grants management and donor funds monitoring systems. The capacities of partners were further enhanced on Implementing Partnership Management (IPM), emergency monitoring and reporting.In preparation for the new Country Programme (CP) strategic planning for the 2026–2030 cycle, the RRBM (Rights and Results Based Management) capacity development of the country office team was prioritized, causality and bottleneck analyses were completed, and draft Theories of Change were developed.
